title: Identity or Prompt Noise? A Calibrated Invariance Audit of LLM Code Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual persona assignment in prompts using 234 occupation labels to measure variance in code generation structure (CodeBLEU) and functional correctness against a label-exchangeability null via within-task randomization.
